description: Pattern-based prevention rules for TowerDefense01 — Go + Ebiten tower defense game

rules.name: Hardcoded 1.0/60.0 frame time
rules.message: Hardcoded 1.0/60.0 frame time — physics break on non-60 FPS displays
rules.suggestion: Use Ebiten's actual delta: dt := 1.0 / float64(ebiten.CurrentTPS()); or use a fixed timestep accumulator

rules.name: O(n*m) enemy targeting — linear scan all enemies per tower
rules.message: Tower/enemy linear scan — O(n*m) targeting, will lag with many entities. Use spatial partitioning.
rules.suggestion: Use a spatial grid: divide playfield into cells, check only nearby cells for enemy targeting

rules.name: Excessive asset directory without atlas
rules.message: Large asset directory detected without sprite atlas or compression — bloated repo and slow loading
rules.suggestion: Pack sprites into texture atlases, compress audio to OGG/Vorbis, remove unused assets

rules.name: No spatial partitioning for entity queries
rules.message: Entity count check in hot path without spatial partitioning — O(n) or O(n²) collision/targeting
rules.suggestion: Implement a spatial grid: type Grid struct { cells [][][]Entity; cellSize float64 }

rules.name: Frame-count-based logic instead of delta time
rules.message: Frame-count-based timing — logic runs at different speeds on different FPS. Use delta time.
rules.suggestion: Use time.Now() and time.Since() for timing: elapsed := time.Since(lastUpdate).Seconds()

rules.name: Go: Ignored error return
rules.message: Error return value ignored. Always check errors in Go.
rules.suggestion: Handle the error: if err != nil { return err }

rules.name: Go: defer in loop
rules.message: defer in loop — deferred calls accumulate until function returns, may leak resources
rules.suggestion: Wrap loop body in a function or call .Close() directly

rules.name: Ebiten: DrawImage without layout optimization
rules.message: DrawImage without DrawImageOptions — no filtering or transform control
rules.suggestion: Use op := &ebiten.DrawImageOptions{} for proper transform and filtering control

rules.name: Go: Global mutable state for game
rules.message: Global mutable variable — game state should be encapsulated in a struct passed to Ebiten
rules.suggestion: Encapsulate game state in a Game struct: type Game struct { ... }; implement ebiten.Game interface
